A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee of the party in question. Candidates other than the Democratic or Republican nominee (e.g., Greens, Libertarian, independent) may be added at a later date.

Candidates who run as independents will not be encompassed by the “Democrat” or “Republican” options regardless of any affiliation they may have with the party.

The candidates may be named in the contract for the convenience of traders. In the event that any named candidate is replaced as the nominee of their respective party prior to election day, the name in the contract will be updated and the market will resolve based on the replacement nominee of the party.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on the official certification.

recent_facts.fact: In recent Ohio governor polls, Democrat Amy Acton led in five: CNN/SSRS (Sep 29–Oct 5, 760 likely voters) had Acton 50%, Ramaswamy 42%. NYT/Siena (Sep 22–Oct 1, 616 likely voters) had Acton 49%, Ramaswamy 45%. YouGov (Sep 18–30, 3,777 likely voters) had Acton 48%, Ramaswamy 44%. Suffolk (Sep 23–27, 500 voters) had Acton 50%, Ramaswamy 41%. Marist (Sep 24–27, 1,298 registered voters) had Acton 50%, Ramaswamy 44%.

Republican Vivek Ramaswamy led 45% to 43% in a co/efficient poll (Oct 5–6, 925 likely voters, margin of error ±3.49). In that poll, 8% were undecided and 3% backed the Libertarian. It was the only recent poll cited with Ramaswamy ahead.
Pollsmax's polling average across 27 polls has Acton 47.1% and Ramaswamy 45.1%, an Acton lead of 2.0 points. RealClearPolling's average had Acton ahead by 3.8 points in early October.
Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball both rate the Ohio governor race a Toss-up.

In Ohio, final RealClearPolitics averages understated the Republican margin in 4 of 4 recent cases cited. Trump led polls by 2.2 and won by 8.1 (2016), led by 1.0 and won by 8.2 (2020), and led by 9.3 and won by 11.2 (2024). In the 2024 Senate race, Moreno led by 1.7 and won by 3.6. This is one outlet's comparison of averages, not a formal study.
Trump won Ohio by 8 points in both 2016 and 2020, and by 11 points in 2024.

The Republican ticket is Vivek Ramaswamy with running mate Rob McColley. The Democratic ticket is Amy Acton with running mate David Pepper. Incumbent Republican Mike DeWine is term-limited. The election is November 3, 2026.
Acton has turned down debate invitations, including a CNN debate that Ramaswamy accepted. On Sep 2 her campaign said her focus was talking with Ohioans, not 'platforming a scam artist.'

Coverage of the Marist and Suffolk polls in early October reported that Acton's lead over Ramaswamy had grown compared with earlier polls. Earlier in the cycle, some polls, including Bowling Green, had the race a dead heat or Ramaswamy up 1.

Acton reported a record fundraising haul but still trailed Ramaswamy's $12.9 million cash on hand in the filing period covered (exact date unclear). The article also notes the two campaigns used different cutoff dates and accounting methods.
Early in-person and absentee voting in Ohio began October 6 and runs through November 1. Absentee ballot requests are due by 8:30 p.m. October 27, and Election Day is November 3.

The question resolves when AP, Fox News, and NBC all call the race for the same candidate; otherwise it resolves on official certification. Independents do not count as Democrats even if they are affiliated with the party.

market.question: Perim Island no longer under Houthi control by October 15?
market.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Perim Island is no longer under Houthi control by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

“The Houthis” refers to the Houthi movement (Ansar Allah), including its governing institutions and any armed force operating under its direction or on its behalf. “Perim Island” refers to Perim (Mayyun) Island in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, Yemen.

“No longer under the control of the Houthis” means that the Houthis no longer exercise primary military control over Perim Island, and another state, occupying force, the internationally recognized government of Yemen, or an internationally backed authority has established control over the island.

Temporary raids, isolated landings, special operations, bombardment, sabotage, naval presence offshore, or temporary disruption of Houthi activity will not qualify on their own.

An announcement, threat, or claim that the Houthis have lost control will not qualify without actual control being established.

If control changes pursuant to a negotiated settlement, ceasefire term, surrender, or transfer agreement, this will qualify only once actual control has been established on the island.

If control over Perim Island is contested, unclear, disputed, or not sufficiently established by the resolution date, this will not qualify, and the market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution source will be official statements from the relevant governments and militaries, along with a consensus of credible reporting.

market.rules:

87500.00, then the market resolves to Yes.
At each minute throughout the market duration, a settlement value is calculated using every minute-by-minute CF BRTI price for BTC. For each of these individual minute-by-minute checks, the top 20% and bottom 20% of the cumulative dataset are removed before calculating the average of the remaining values. If the trimmed mean associated with any single minute during the period is above the threshold, the market resolves to Yes. This methodology reduces the impact of extreme price spikes or drops. The measurement period runs from when the market is issued until the specified end time. If CF Benchmarks data is unavailable or incomplete at the expiration time, affected strikes resolve to No. For cryptocurrencies with multiple versions, the Exchange will specify which version or ticker is being tracked.
